missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Руководитель' is an animate masculine noun in the nominative case as the subject. 'Наш' is the agreeing possessive, and 'строгий' is the predicate adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative equals genitive for animates. 'Руководителя' takes the animate accusative ending -я because the noun is animate masculine. 'Этого' agrees in the same form.
Strategic focus: Genitive of belonging. 'Руководителя' is the genitive form showing whose office it is. 'Нашего' is the agreeing masculine genitive possessive, and 'кабинет' is the nominative.

missions.phrase: Я подошёл к руководителю с вопросом.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative with 'к'. 'Руководителю' is the dative form after 'к', expressing movement toward the person. 'С вопросом' is an instrumental phrase of accompaniment.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of role. 'Руководителем' is the instrumental form after 'стал', the standard case for naming a position one assumes. 'Отдела' is the genitive modifier.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О руководителе' uses the prepositional form 'руководителе' after 'о' to express the topic. 'Новом' agrees in the masculine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Руководители' is the nominative plural subject of 'собрались'. 'Все' is the agreeing plural quantifier.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural for animates. 'Руководителей' takes the genitive-like accusative plural ending -ей because the noun is animate. 'Наших' agrees in the same animate form.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after a numeral. After 'пять' the noun takes the genitive plural 'руководителей'. 'В компании' is the prepositional location of the count.
Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Руководитель' is nominative as the predicate noun. 'Мой' and 'прямой' are the agreeing masculine modifiers. A clean introduction model.
